victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text: At the end of each turning point after the first:
bullets: If any objective markers are secured by your kill team, you score 1VP
If more objective markers are secured by your kill team than the opponent's kill team, you score 1VP

bullets.text: One objective marker the active operative controls is secured by your kill team until the enemy kill team secures that objective marker
An operative cannot perform this action during the first turning point, or while within control range of an enemy operative.

victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text: Whenever a friendly operative performs the Loot action, you score 1VP (to a maximum of 2VP per turning point).

bullets.text: One objective marker the active operative controls is looted.

An operative cannot perform this action during the first turning point, while within control range of an enemy operative, or if that objective marker has already been looted during this turning point.

victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text: At the end of each turning point after the first:
bullets: If friendly operatives control any transmitting objective markers, you score 1VP.
If friendly operatives control more transmitting objective markers than enemy operatives do, you score 1VP.

bullets.text: One objective marker the active operative controls is transmitting until the start of the next turning point.
An operative cannot perform this action during the first turning point, or while within control range of an enemy operative.

If the active operative controls the objective marker that has the Orb token, move that token: from the centre objective marker to either player's objective marker (your choice), or from a player's objective marker to the centre objective marker.
An operative cannot perform this action during the first turning point, while within control range of an enemy operative, or if it doesn't control the objective marker that has the Orb token.

victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text: At the end of each turning point after the first, for each objective marker that friendly operatives control that doesn't have the Orb token, you score 1VP.

additionalRules.title: ADDITIONAL RULES
additionalRules.text: At the start of the battle, the centre objective marker has the Orb token.

victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text: At the end of each turning point after the first:
bullets: If friendly operatives control more objective markers than enemy operatives do, you score 1VP.
If your selected claim is true, you score 1VP.

additionalRules.title: ADDITIONAL RULES
additionalRules.text: At the start of the Gambit step of each Strategy phase after the first, starting with the player with initiative, each player selects one objective marker and one claim for that turning point: friendly operatives will control that objective marker at the end of this turning point, or enemy operatives won't contest it at the end of this turning point. Each player must select each objective marker once during the battle. The Stake Claim marker is removed at the end of the turning point.

victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text:
At the end of each turning point after the first, if friendly operatives control more objective markers than enemy operatives do, you score 1VP.

At the end of the battle, for each objective marker friendly operatives are carrying, you score 1VP.

additionalRules.title: ADDITIONAL RULES
additionalRules.text: Operatives can perform the Pick Up Marker action upon objective markers in turning point 2 for an additional 2AP, in turning point 3 for an additional 1AP (in both cases that action cannot be free and its AP cannot be reduced), and as normal in turning point 4. An operative carrying an objective marker cannot be removed and set up again more than 6" away.

bullets.text: One centre or opponent's objective marker the active operative controls is downloaded.

An operative cannot perform this action during the first or second turning point, while within control range of an enemy operative, or if that objective marker has already been downloaded during the battle.

victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text:
At the end of each turning point after the first, if friendly operatives control more objective markers than enemy operatives do, you score 1VP. Ignore downloaded objective markers when determining this.

Whenever a friendly operative performs the Download action during the third turning point, you score 1VP; during the fourth turning point, you score 2VP.

bullets.text: One objective marker the active operative controls gains 1 Data point. Use a dice as a token to keep track of Data points at that objective marker.

An operative cannot perform this action during the first turning point, while within control range of an enemy operative, or if that objective marker has already gained a Data point during this turning point.
Remove all Data points from an objective marker the active operative controls.

An operative cannot perform this action during the first, second or third turning point, while within control range of an enemy operative, or if that objective marker doesn't have any Data points to remove.

victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text:
At the end of the second and third turning point, if friendly operatives have performed more Compile Data actions during that turning point than enemy operatives have, you score 1VP.

Whenever a friendly operative performs the Send Data action, you score a number of VP equal to the number of Data points removed.

bullets.text: One inert objective marker the active operative controls is no longer inert.
An operative cannot perform this action during the first turning point, or while within control range of an enemy operative.

victoryPoints.title: VICTORY POINTS
victoryPoints.text: At the end of each turning point after the first, for each objective marker friendly operatives control, you score 1VP. Ignore inert objective markers when determining this.

additionalRules.title: ADDITIONAL RULES
additionalRules.text: When setting up the battle, number the objective markers 1-3. At the start of the Gambit step of each Strategy phase, each player secretly selects one objective marker (hold that many dice in your hand), then both reveal: if they picked the same one, that objective marker is inert during this turning point; otherwise, the one neither player picked is inert.
